title: Operation
description: A command over the model: its subject, effect, input, outcomes, errors and the process events it fires (model/operations/, in a sub-folder named after the subject's file stem when it has one).

subject.description: The entity the operation acts on; not owning. The file lives in model/operations/<subject file stem>/.

level.description: record: one record of the subject, whose key the operation takes implicitly; collection: the whole set. Means something only with a subject (MQ3023).

effect.description: Whether the operation only reads data or changes it.

input.description: The input members, in file order.

outcomes.description: The ways the operation ends, in file order.

defaultOutcome.description: One of the operation's own outcomes (MQ3028); absent, the first.

errors.description: The operation's own errors, in file order.

guards.description: Conditions the operation requires, checked in order: the first that does not hold reports its error. Only true passes.

redefines.description: Per-operation exceptions to the errors the operation inherits from its stereotypes: each entry names a stereotype error by its id and states only the facets it changes (input, displayName, description). The error keeps its keyed id (<operation id>.<error id>); name and code are not redefinable (MQ2027).

excludes.description: Ids of stereotype errors the operation does not inherit (MQ2028).

fires.description: Process event ids, of any process, that the operation fires.

requires.description: Ids of any element or sub-element that stand for what the operation requires; the engine gives the list no meaning (MQ3031).

rationale.description: Markdown text: why the element is shaped this way.

decision.description: A URL or a reference (such as ADR-0042) of the decision record. It is not an element id and is not checked.

excludeStereotypes.description: Stereotype keys that a database schema's or a package's defaultStereotypes would give this element, left out with the stereotypes they imply. Only defaults can be excluded (MQ2029).

member.title: Operation member
member.description: An input member, or a member of an outcome's inline returns: exactly one of a typed value (type), a record key (keyOf) or a file (file) (MQ3024).

type.description: A typed value's type, as an attribute takes it: a built-in keyword or a reference to an enum, value object, custom scalar type or reference type.

keyOf.description: A record key: the id of the entity whose record's key the member holds (with collection, a list of keys).

file.description: A file: bytes with a name and a media type; length caps its size in bytes.

mediaTypes.description: The media types a file member accepts; empty accepts any. Only on a file (MQ3024).

default.description: The value a typed input member takes when none is given; never on a record key or a member of a returns (MQ3024).

rationale.description: Markdown text: why the element is shaped this way.

decision.description: A URL or a reference (such as ADR-0042) of the decision record. It is not an element id and is not checked.

completes.description: now: the work is done when the outcome is reported; later: accepted and waiting.

returns.description: What the outcome returns; absent, it returns nothing.

rationale.description: Markdown text: why the element is shaped this way.

decision.description: A URL or a reference (such as ADR-0042) of the decision record. It is not an element id and is not checked.

returns.title: Returns
returns.description: What an outcome returns: exactly one of members, entity or file (MQ3025). It has no id; it is part of its outcome.

members.description: An inline shape: at least one member.

entity.description: Records of an entity, its attributes as the shape.

file.description: A file (a download; streaming is a file).

mediaTypes.description: The media types a file result may have, the first the usual one. Only beside file (MQ3025).

list.description: Whether a list is returned; never beside file (MQ3025).

paging.description: How a list is paged: page (a page number) or cursor (an opaque cursor). Set with list and maxPageSize (MQ3025); the paging inputs are implied, never declared as members.

maxPageSize.description: The largest page a caller may ask for; set with paging (MQ3025).

guard.title: Operation guard
guard.description: A condition the operation requires before it runs, and the error it raises when the condition does not hold.

condition.description: The condition, a boolean expression over the input members and, for a record operation, the subject.

error.description: The error the guard raises: an own error's id or an inherited one's keyed id (MQ3111).

rationale.description: Markdown text: why the element is shaped this way.

decision.description: A URL or a reference (such as ADR-0042) of the decision record. It is not an element id and is not checked.

errorRedefinition.title: Error redefinition
errorRedefinition.description: An exception to one inherited error: the stereotype error it names (member) and the facets it states. It has no id of its own.

member.description: The id of the stereotype error the entry redefines.

input.description: The input member of this operation the error points at (MQ3027).

displayName.description: The display name for this operation; it shows in every locale.
